newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rig count up 8 to 853 in latest week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rig count up 8 to 853 in latest week.

text.p: The number of rigs exploring for oil and natural gas in the United States stood at 853 as of Oct. 25, up eight from the prior week and 92 above the year-ago total of 761, Baker Hughes Inc. said Friday.
The number of rigs drilling on land rose by seven to 723, while rigs working offshore fell by two to 104. The number of rigs active in inland waters rose by three to 26.
The biggest change in individual states occurred in Texas, which showed an increase of 12, and Colorado, which showed a decrease of three. Kansas rose by three and Wyoming was up one.
A total of 336 rigs were exploring for crude oil, up 17 from last week. The number of rigs searching for gas fell by 11 to 503, while the number of miscellaneous drilling projects rose by two to 14.
In Canada, the number of working rigs fell by six to 302 vs. 212 a year ago.
The weekly rig count reflects the number of rigs exploring for oil and gas, not those producing oil and gas.
